subject.title: Feature: preserve completed progress draft in Telegram progress mode

question: Should Telegram progress mode gain a default-off option that preserves the full completed progress draft, including checklist-style state, while sending the final answer as a separate normal message?
rationale: Current main intentionally collapses the progress window into a compact summary and has no accepted public config for full completed-draft retention, so this is a new lifecycle/config policy rather than a broken existing contract.

options.title: Accept default-off preserve mode
options.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned keep-on-complete or finalization option while preserving the current collapse-summary lifecycle as the default.

options.title: Keep current collapse summary
options.body: Decline full completed-draft preservation for now and keep the current final-answer plus compact activity digest behavior.

options.title: Defer to structured progress cards
options.body: Track this as a cross-channel structured progress-card design so checklist state has a typed contract before Telegram exposes it.

recommendation.title: Accept default-off preserve mode
recommendation.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned keep-on-complete or finalization option while preserving the current collapse-summary lifecycle as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the most targeted recent commit on the Telegram collapse-bar fallback path the option would change.
